items.html: And you must also know that first enters the lowest filling in the degree, which is the 19 of the filling of MA — whether because it is the smallest of them all in degree, or for another reason, which is that the matter of ZA having these three Names, AB, SAG, MA, is that first he takes the phase of his own life, which is the filling of MA, and afterwards he takes a greater life, which is the filling of SAG, and takes it from Ima. And afterwards he takes from Abba a life greater than all of them, which is the filling of AB. And therefore it is necessary that first there be the filling of 19, which is the life of his own self, and afterwards that of 37, and afterwards that of 46, for so is the ascent of the degrees.
